Take the first step toward understanding your or your child’s learning, attention, or cognitive challenges. Our no-obligation consultation helps determine if our assessment services are the right fit for your needs.

[Book Your Free Consultation Now](#calendar) [(213) 495-1155](tel:2134951155)

## How It Works: Our Simple 3-Step Process

### 1. Free Consultation

Schedule a 15-minute Zoom call with Dr. Trampush to discuss your concerns and determine if our services meet your needs.

**Timeline:** Same week availability

### 2. Assessment

Complete comprehensive testing tailored to your specific concerns (typically 4-8 hours across multiple sessions).

**Timeline:** 1-2 weeks after consultation

### 3. Results & Action Plan

Receive detailed findings, diagnosis (if applicable), and actionable recommendations for home, school, or work.

**Timeline:** 2-3 weeks after testing

> **IMPORTANT:**
>
> We respond to all inquiries within 24-48 hours during business days.

## Additional Services

### Telemedicine Options

We offer telemedicine services for the initial consultation and feedback sessions. In-person testing is typically required for the assessment portion.

### Testing at Home

In some cases, we can provide testing services at your home or place of residence for an additional fee. Please inquire during your consultation.

## Insurance & Fees

While we don’t accept direct insurance payments, we provide detailed documentation that many clients successfully submit for out-of-network reimbursement. Assessment costs typically range from \$2,000-\$7,000 depending on complexity and specific needs.
